title: Corkboard
blurb: Coordinate-addressable canvas, independent of the rich editor
note: McCorkboard projects a McCorkboardDocument, which holds McCorkboardPanelModel instances. It also projects a McFloatyDocument, whose cards come from floaty directives in a file; McFloaty reads headings with McMarkdownParser, which is why the markdown chain is loaded here in the same order rich-edit needs it.
